name: state
meaning: TrainStationState: 0 idle, 1 the train is on this station's route

name: train
meaning: sender of msg 0x4800 / 0x60 (Train, class 135)

name: passenger
meaning: train msg 0x4783 reply; the station camera looks at it

name: timerTicks
meaning: g_dt accumulated since the last command

name: lastSegTimeMs
meaning: distXZ(p[n-2],p[n-1])*1000/(SPEEDPERCENT*15); returned by msg 0x4801

name: prevSegTimeMs
meaning: same for segment n-3..n-2

name: jamsArrivingTimeMs
meaning: ARRIVINGTIME of the registered TrafficJams (msg 0x5F arg)

name: commandPending
meaning: a waypoint command is waiting for its delay

name: skipWait
meaning: msg 0x60 arrived while a command was pending; the next jam query passes NULL (no wait)

name: camActive
meaning: station camera started; released when there is no passenger

name: jammed
meaning: TrafficJams msg 0x1E reply

name: waypoint
meaning: target sent to the train (arg of 0x4781/0x60/0x4782 together with +0x72)

name: waypointHeading
meaning: atan2 heading for the waypoint (+0x800 on non-final points)

name: waypointIndex
meaning: current trajectory point

name: trafficJams
meaning: TrafficJams (class 133) registered by msg 0x5F

name: box
meaning: BOX; written by Init, no reader found in TrainStation or Train code

name: traj
meaning: TRAJ {u16 count; Vec3s pts[]}, >= 3 points, straightened in place by Init

name: next
meaning: NEXT station (class 136 only); handed to the train via msg 0x60's out-arg at route end

name: waitTicks
meaning: WAIT ms -> ticks; written by Init, no reader found

name: camera
meaning: CAM setup record {u16 focal; s16 rot[3]; Vec3s eye}

name: speedPercent
meaning: SPEEDPERCENT; msg 0x4802 reply (the train sets speed -1500*pct/100)
